scope: Exploratory retrospective comparison of unchanged metric implementations. No final-VP, policy improvement, physical-step accounting or causal attribution claim.

design.window: Non-phasing O at start of P player turn, Game Turns 2-8 with a following row. Outcomes are those recorded during P turn. Moving features refer to P at the same start point.
design.identity: Initial hash, final hash and canonical accepted-action sequence. All aliases and both policy seats of a map seed stay in one fold.
design.split: Leave one map seed out within each role subset. No tuning, no feature selection from results.
design.models: Zero, training median/mean, baseline ridge regression, baseline plus metric ridge regression, and train-only baseline/metric bucket medians. Added feature penalty 1; baseline and intercept unpenalized.
design.buckets: Separate negative sentinel; 0; (0,1]; (1,3]; (3,7]; >7. Fixed before this comparison, adapting the earlier integer buckets to fractional metrics. Unseen bucket uses training median.
design.intervals: 1000 paired seed-cluster bootstrap draws on fixed held-out errors, without refitting or multiplicity correction. Exploratory with few seeds.
design.outcomes: combatStepsLost and attritionStepsLost retain the current recorder classification. They count STEP_LOST events, not guaranteed physical steps or pure combat causes. outOfTraceRise is positive net change, not proven enemy-caused disruption.

intervals.scope: Paired map-seed cluster resampling of fixed held-out errors. Conditional on fitted folds; no refitting or model-selection uncertainty.
